heroHeadline: Residente Details Porto Rico Film Pre-Production in Deadline Interview — Filming Late 2026 in Puerto Rico; European Stadium Leg Opens Barcelona in 8 Days; Adidas Flamboyan Drops Tomorrow at All The Right NYC
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. Director Residente gave Deadline the most detailed public account yet of *Porto Rico* pre-production — confirming principal photography is expected to begin late 2026 in Puerto Rico, with Bad Bunny as lead playing 19th-century Puerto Rican revolutionary José Maldonado Román ("Aguila Blanca"), alongside Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem, executive produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour's first-ever European stadium run opens in 8 days — May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (sold out) — Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years, before continuing to Lisbon, Madrid, and 11 countries through July 22 in Brussels. The Adidas Ballerina "Flamboyan" (Vivid Red, named for Puerto Rico's iconic flamboyán tree) drops tomorrow at All The Right NYC, with wide release May 30 via Adidas Confirmed. The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart has "DtMF" at 58+ consecutive weeks at No. 1 — the all-time record.
